text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Huh, where's the bounty target—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So-so. The return deadline for the 
Western movie I rented is coming up, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It felt like a waste if I didn't watch it 
all, so I stayed up without sleeping to 
watch... *yawn*

Taiki Shuttle continued to look sleepy the 
entire time afterward...
